high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and accompanying photo related to a business acquisition. Below the headline, there is a subheading that states: "Ravalgaon Sugar Farm, which owns brands such as Mango Mood, Coffee Break, Tutty Fruity, Paan Pasand, etc has sold its trademarks, recipes, all intellectual property rights to Reliance Consumer Products."
